statements.status_notes: This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile link-fallback fix so extraction is skipped when a custom filter returns None. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-87910 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/157305

This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile hard-link extraction fix so hard links to symbolic links cannot bypass the data and tar filters. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-82049 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/157454

This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile link-fallback fix so extraction is skipped when a custom filter returns None. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-87910 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/157305

This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile hard-link extraction fix so hard links to symbolic links cannot bypass the data and tar filters. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-82049 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/157454

The Python 3.14 DHI package backports CPython's RFC 3454 stringprep fix to use Unicode 3.2 attributes. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-17084 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/155293

This DHI package backports CPython's bounded decompression fix for BZIP2 and LZMA ZIP members, plus Zstandard where available, preventing attacker-controlled unbounded decompression output. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-15310 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/156003

This DHI package backports CPython's tarfile extraction-filter fix, preventing crafted member names from leaving and returning to the extraction destination. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-19672 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/156000

This DHI package backports CPython's URL-scheme-aware HTTPPasswordMgr credential matching fix, preventing HTTPS credentials from matching HTTP requests. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-15806 and https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/155696

Python 3.14.6 includes the upstream remote debugging / asyncio introspection bounds-check fix from https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/148187, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped DHI package.

Python 3.13.14 and 3.14.6 already include the upstream bz2 decompressor fix in the packaged source tarball, so the vulnerable code is not present in the shipped DHI package. See https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/150599
SSRF in Python stdlib ftplib.ftpcp(). An upstream CPython patch exists, but these packaged Python streams do not yet have a fixed release available; monitoring for fixed packages.
DHI backport applied; upstream equivalent fix is https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/143924
